initiatives.name: Food Not Bombs St. Pete
initiatives.description: St. Petersburg, Florida chapter of Food Not Bombs. Serves free vegan and vegetarian meals from recovered and donated food at Williams Park on Mondays, Wednesdays and Saturdays.

initiatives.name: St. Pete Copwatch
initiatives.description: Dedicated to holding law enforcement accountable in St. Petersburg and the greater Tampa Bay area.

initiatives.name: St. Petersburg Tenants Union
initiatives.description: Tenant group in St. Petersburg, Florida that holds know-your-rights workshops and pushes the city on rent control, eviction notice rules, and tenant protections.

initiatives.name: Queer Expression
initiatives.description: Queer Expression (QE) St Pete is a completely grassroots volunteer collective that provides multigenerational community spaces for Queer and Trans folks.
